notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
The demo of Dollhouse of Dead has finally emerged from the shadows. Dare to step inside?

Thanks to the screams and whispers of our playtesters, we have reshaped parts of the nightmare:

Certain creatures have been altered, their forms twisted into something more… unsettling

Balance has been reworked to ensure every encounter keeps you on edge

Countless cracks in the walls have been sealed—bugs and glitches exorcised to let the horror breathe as intended

This is only the beginning. Enter the dollhouse, explore its dark corners, and let us know what terrors you uncover. Your feedback fuels the nightmare
